description.value: Hanoi Old Quarter is a Northern Vietnamese restaurant in Kitsilano founded by Head Chef Hong Duong and Owner Rose Nguyen, whose family roots trace back to a phở street cart in Hanoi. The menu centres on regional specialties — bánh xèo, turmeric fish (chả cá), short rib phở, and steamed rice rolls — alongside curated Vietnamese-inspired cocktails and BC wines. The restaurant's story is deeply personal, framing each dish as a tribute to the matriarchs and culinary traditions of northern Vietnam.
